What I do

Services

From full renovations to targeted upgrades — all work personally done, with full insurance coverage.

Bathroom Renovation
Complete bathroom transformations — tiling, upgrades, new fittings and full sanitary installation.
Kitchen Remodelling
Kitchen fitting and installation, splashback tiling — from simple updates to full kitchen builds.
Painting & Finishing
Interior painting, plaster repair, stucco application and thorough wall preparation for perfect results.
Flooring
Hardwood, laminate, vinyl plank and tile installation. Subfloor levelling and preparation included.
Carpentry & Furniture Assembly
Professional flat-pack and custom furniture assembly — IKEA and more; customised built-in wardrobes, cabinets or staircases.
General Repairs
Drywalling, crack filling, fittings and general maintenance — keeping your home in top condition.

Hello! My name is Stoyan, and I live in Voorburg. After previously living in the Netherlands and working for various construction companies, I moved back in 2017 and founded The Home Renovator.

Over the past years, The Home Renovator started as a side project and a passion of mine — combining my love for home renovations with the satisfaction of seeing happy clients when a project is completed.

This year, I decided to dedicate more time to this passion. I now work part-time for an engineering company building water systems, to be able to spend more time working on renovation projects, practising sports, and enjoying time with my two-year-old daughter.

I would love to support you with your renovation projects, whether big or small, and help turn your ideas into a home you truly enjoy living in.

Aansprakelijkheidsverzekering — fully insured
